title: Introduction to HTML
description: Basic HTML concepts and structure. This quiz covers fundamental HTML elements, tags, and document structure.

questions.explanation: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language, which is the standard markup language for creating web pages.
HTML is a markup language, not a programming language. It describes the structure of web content.

questions.text: The root element of an HTML document is the _____ tag.
questions.explanation: The <html> tag is the root element that contains all other HTML elements.

title: CSS Fundamentals
description: Learn about CSS selectors, properties, and basic styling techniques. This quiz tests your understanding of Cascading Style Sheets.

questions.text: Which CSS property controls the text color?
questions.explanation: The 'color' property sets the color of text in CSS.

questions.text: What is the correct CSS syntax for changing the font?
questions.explanation: CSS properties use a colon (:) to separate the property from its value, and end with a semicolon (;).

title: JavaScript Basics
description: Test your knowledge of JavaScript fundamentals including variables, functions, and basic syntax.

questions.text: How do you declare a variable in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: JavaScript uses 'var', 'let', or 'const' to declare variables.
Yes, JavaScript is case-sensitive. 'myVariable' and 'MyVariable' are different variables.

questions.text: The _____ keyword is used to declare a constant in JavaScript.
questions.explanation: The 'const' keyword declares a constant that cannot be reassigned.

questions.text: What is the result of 2 + '2' in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: JavaScript performs type coercion, converting the number 2 to a string and concatenating them, resulting in '22'.

title: React Components
description: Test your understanding of React components, props, and state management.

options: A JavaScript function that returns HTML
questions.correctAnswer: A JavaScript function that returns HTML
questions.explanation: React components are JavaScript functions that return JSX (HTML-like syntax) to describe what should appear on the screen.
Props are read-only and cannot be modified by the component. They are passed down from parent components.

title: Database Design
description: Fundamentals of database design, normalization, and SQL basics.

options: A field that can contain duplicate values
A field that uniquely identifies each record
A field that contains text only
questions.correctAnswer: A field that uniquely identifies each record
questions.explanation: A primary key is a field that uniquely identifies each record in a database table.

questions.text: The process of organizing data to reduce redundancy is called _____.
questions.explanation: Normalization is the process of organizing data in a database to reduce redundancy and improve data integrity.
